meta.name: weekly-digests
meta.description: Generate a serial week-by-week narrative digest of a project's full claude-mem timeline. Splits the timeline into per-ISO-week files, then runs one consecutive subagent per week — each receiving the prior week's carry-forward block — to produce one chapter per ISO week of data. Use when asked for "weekly digests", "week-by-week story", "serial timeline", or "narrative chapters" of a project's history.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目历史按周生成连续叙事回顾
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望把项目记录自动整理成每周连续的叙事摘要
copy.tagline_en: Turn your project timeline into a week-by-week narrative.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want automatic weekly narrative summaries of your project history.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把项目的 claude-mem 时间线按 ISO 周切成多个文件，再按时间顺序每周派一个子代理，产出一章叙事摘要；每个子代理会接收上一周的交接内容，让各章保持连贯。
howto.when: 当你要求「每周摘要」「逐周故事」「连载时间线」等，或想按周为单位生成项目历史的叙事章节时触发。它面向多章连载格式；若只想要一份整体报告，应改用 timeline-report。

say.text: 给这个项目做每周摘要，从第一周一直写到现在
say.note: 按 ISO 周逐周生成多章摘要

say.text: 把 [项目] 的历史写成逐周连载故事
say.note: 每周一章，接收上周交接以保持连贯

say.text: 接着上周，继续写下一周的叙事章节
say.note: 沿用上一章的交接块继续连载

howto.what_en: Claude splits the project's claude-mem timeline into per-ISO-week files, then runs one subagent per week to write one narrative chapter per week. Each subagent gets the prior week's carry-forward block, keeping the chapters connected.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for "weekly digests", "week-by-week story", or "serial timeline", or want weekly narrative chapters of a project's history. For one sweeping report, use timeline-report.

say_en.text: Make weekly digests for this project, from the first week to now.
say_en.note: Writes one chapter per ISO week

say_en.text: Write the history of [project] as a week-by-week serial story.
say_en.note: Each chapter inherits the prior week's carry-forward

say_en.text: Continue from last week with the next narrative chapter.
say_en.note: Reuses the previous chapter's carry-forward block
